PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_OpeningShadingType
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all shading types as referred to by other property sets

PropertyDef.Name: ExternalShadingCoefficient
PropertyDef.Definition: radiation transmission coefficient of the outside shading device. It is a value without unit. The following translations apply: G: Durchlasfaktor Sonnenschutz ausen, JA: GAIBU SHAHEI-KEISU

PropertyDef.Name: InternalShadingCoefficient
PropertyDef.Definition: radiation transmission coefficient of the inside shading device, symbol "b-value". It is a value without unit. The following translations apply: G: Durchlasfaktor Sonnenschutz innen, JA: NAIBU SHAHEI-KEISU

PropertyDef.Name: InsetShadingCoefficient
PropertyDef.Definition: radiation transmission coefficient of the shading device inside the glazing, symbol "b-value". It is a value without unit. The following translations apply: G: Durchlasfaktor Sonnenschutz innerhalb der Verglasung, JA: KUMIKOMI SHAHEI-KEISU

PropertyDef.Name: DistanceToLateralShadingLeft
PropertyDef.Definition: Distance between the lateral shading device and the window or door opening as shown in the figure.

PropertyDef.Name: DistanceToLateralShadingRight
PropertyDef.Definition: Distance between the lateral shading device and the window or door opening as shown in the figure.

PropertyDef.Name: ProjectionOfLateralShading
PropertyDef.Definition: Projection of the lateral shading device from the facade (outer surface of the building element, in which the door or window is located)

PropertyDef.Name: DistanceToTopShading
PropertyDef.Definition: Distance between the shading device on top and the window or door opening as shown in the figure.

PropertyDef.Name: ProjectionOfTopShading
PropertyDef.Definition: Projection of the shading device on the top from the facade (outer surface of the building element, in which the door or window is located)
